user.title: Connect Proton Drive Backup
user.description: Enable native backup mode and sign in to Proton in the Proton Drive Backup app first. Enter the app's private address and local pairing token here.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter the new pairing token
reauth_confirm.description: Use the integration_token from the same Proton Drive Backup app. Do not enter your Proton password.

reconfigure.title: Update the app connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the private address and local pairing token of the same app installation.

error.invalid_url: Enter a private HTTP(S) address without credentials, a path, or URL parameters.
error.invalid_auth: Enter the app's local pairing token (32–128 URL-safe characters), not your Proton password.
error.cannot_connect: The app is not reachable. Verify its address and that native backup mode is enabled.
error.authentication_required: Sign in to Proton in the Proton Drive Backup app first, then try again.
error.invalid_backend_response: The app did not respond as expected. Use a matching native-mode app version.

abort.already_configured: This app installation is already paired.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address points to a different app installation. The saved destination was not changed.

invalid_url.message: The saved private app address is not valid.

invalid_auth.message: The app rejected the local pairing token. Update it with the token from the app configuration.

backend_unavailable.message: The Proton Drive Backup app is not reachable or the connection was interrupted.

authentication_required.message: Sign in to Proton again in the Proton Drive Backup app.

installation_mismatch.message: The app at the saved address is not the original paired installation.

invalid_backend_response.message: The backup app returned invalid or incompatible data.

backup_not_found.message: This backup could not be found on Proton Drive.

delete_not_supported.message: Deleting Proton Drive backups is not supported. The remote backup has not been removed.

operation_failed.message: The backup operation was not confirmed by Proton Drive.
